input: Pretty quiet week. Got out for a walk a couple times. Sleep was alright.
Job's the same. Wife and I had dinner with neighbors. Felt good to be social.
Started physical therapy for my knee. Slow going but I'm sticking with it.
Money is tight. Bills coming due. Trying to figure out the next move.
VA appointment got rescheduled again. Three weeks now without my meds. Frustrating.
I haven't really talked to anyone in a couple weeks. Just easier alone honestly.
My phone's been off mostly. Haven't seen the guys in months. Feels like nobody really gets it.
I just don't know what I'm doing anymore. The mission was the point and there's no mission now.
Everyone keeps telling me to find something meaningful. None of it feels worth doing.
I don't see how this gets better. I've tried everything.
What's the point of any of it. Nothing changes no matter what I do.
I feel like I'm stuck in mud. Nothing I do is going to fix this.
Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me.
I've been thinking about ending it. I haven't done anything but the thoughts are there.
My family would be fine. They'd grieve and then they'd move on. I keep coming back to that.
Slept maybe two hours a night this week. Avoiding everyone. The job thing fell through. Don't see a way out.
Drinking again. Wife took the kids to her sister's. I don't blame her.
Better week. PT is working. Slept through the night a few times.
Started back at the gym with a buddy from my unit. Helps to lift heavy things.
VA paperwork is a nightmare. Filed the same form three times. Lost a whole day.
Anniversary of losing my buddy this week. Heavy. But I'm getting through.
Missing my old life some days. The structure, the people. Not great but I'm okay.
I've been getting my affairs in order. Updated the will, told my brother where the safe is.
Started giving away the gear I've held onto since deployment. Don't think I'll need it.
Been thinking about how my kids would feel without me. That's been keeping me here some days.
